entry.title: Before you enter

points.here: Only people who are here with you can see you in Match.
points.erased: Everything in Match is erased when you leave the venue, unless you both follow each other.
points.screenshots: Screenshots exist: others can capture what you share.
points.help: You can ask the venue for discreet help at any time.

entry.gamesGlobalHint: Turn this off to disappear from every game in every venue.
entry.gameSwitchHint: Appear in {{game}} while you are here.

public.title: Meet in public first
public.body: Talk in the venue's chat and meet where there are other people. Tell a friend where you are.

share.title: Share little
share.body: Don't share your address, workplace, financial details or codes. Nobody here needs them.

pressure.title: You can say no
pressure.body: Pass, ignore or block anyone who pressures you. You never owe anyone a reply.

report.title: Report and block
report.body: Use the ⋯ menu on any profile to report or block. Reports reach the venue and the JChat team.

help.title: Ask the venue for help
help.body: From the ⋯ menu you can alert the staff discreetly. Nobody else will see it.

presence.verifying: Checking that you're at the venue…
presence.verifyingHint: This takes a few minutes. Scanning the venue's QR activates Match right away.
presence.error: Couldn't verify your presence. We'll try again shortly.

denied.unavailable: Match isn't available for you at this venue.
denied.age_not_confirmed: Confirm your age in the app to use Match.
denied.games_disabled: Games are turned off in your settings.
denied.invalid_qr: That QR doesn't belong to this venue.
denied.location_required: Turn on location to verify you're at the venue.
denied.no_geofence: This venue can't verify presence yet.
denied.outside_radius: You seem to be outside the venue.
denied.impossible_travel: We couldn't verify your location. Try again in a few minutes.

scanner.title: Scan the venue's QR
scanner.hint: Point the camera at the QR code displayed in the venue.
scanner.permissionNeeded: Camera access is needed to scan the QR.
scanner.invalid: That doesn't look like a venue QR code.

leave.title: Leave {{business}}?
leave.body: Everything you did in Match here (likes, matches and chats) will be deleted. Followed people stay.
leave.error: Couldn't leave right now. Try again.

home.title: Match
home.placeholder: The deck arrives in the next update.
